towers.name: Bone Archer Tower
towers.description: Necromantic archer nest built from cursed remains.
towers.lore: Archers who died at their posts and were not relieved. The bowstrings are sinew; the arrows do not care who they were.

towers.name: Plague Tower
towers.description: Launches toxic clouds that burst over everything nearby.
towers.lore: A cauldron of the last plague, kept warm. Each burst is a village that will never need burying.

towers.name: Frost Wyrm Nest
towers.description: A wyrm hatchling breathes killing cold over the path.
towers.lore: The hatchling was dead before it hatched. It breathes the grave's cold and the path slows to listen.

towers.name: Bone Obelisk
towers.description: Grave-magic pillar that quickens every tower around it.
towers.lore: A spire of spines humming with grave-song. Around it the dead work faster, because the dead do not rest.
